name: Metric definition reconciliation
summary: When two reports give different numbers for one metric, the owner gets a page: the definitions side by side, the gap bridged step by step from supplied records, each cause marked shown or not, and a proposed common measure. The owner chooses.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of analytics and reporting work, and its own rules for prepared work: the supplied definitions and rows as the only evidence, every cause marked shown or not shown, and a named owner who decides.
